configurations.name: founder-os-backend
runtimeArgs: import os, sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'backend'); from dotenv import load_dotenv; load_dotenv('backend/.env'); import uvicorn; uvicorn.run('main:app', host='127.0.0.1', port=int(os.environ.get('PORT', '8000')))

configurations.name: founder-os-preview
runtimeArgs: import os, sys, tempfile; d = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='founder-os-preview-').replace(chr(92), '/'); os.environ.update(DATABASE_URL='sqlite:///' + d + '/preview.db', VAULT_REPO_URL='https://127.0.0.1/none.git', VAULT_LOCAL_PATH=d + '/vault', JOBS_IN_PROCESS='0', OPENAI_API_KEY='', ANTHROPIC_API_KEY='', FOUNDER_OS_PASSWORD='', DOTENV_DISABLED='1'); os.chdir('backend'); sys.path.insert(0, '.'); import uvicorn; uvicorn.run('main:app', host='127.0.0.1', port=int(os.environ.get('PORT', '8010')))
